name: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic

accessibility.description: Voice of the Old Republic adds screen-reader output, navigation assistance, menu access and audio cues for minigames. The author reports that all quests, playstyles and minigames in Knights of the Old Republic I are completable. Requires the Steam or GOG Windows version 1.03, Windows 10 or later and a screen reader; minigames use keyboard controls. This support does not cover macOS, mobile versions or Knights of the Old Republic II.
